text.summary: The v2.31.0 migration is building an index on stock_levels without CONCURRENTLY, and its lock queues every write, so reservations time out with 503s. RB-01's mitigation steps can release the lock, but RB-01 says rebuilding the index is a human decision, so this escalates.

plan.action: identify the blocking session in pg_stat_activity
plan.rationale: Confirms process 48190 is the lock holder before anything is changed.

plan.action: set lock_timeout on the migration role
plan.rationale: Stops a future migration from queueing writes behind it for minutes.
Prevents the next deploy from re-running the same migration while this is handled.

plan.action: cancel the migration backend with pg_cancel_backend
plan.rationale: Releases the lock immediately, but abandons 41% of an index build, so a human confirms.

rejected.because: NOT effective when the change is a database migration that is still running - the index build is still running and rolling back application code does not release its lock.
not for sessions blocked on a table lock - the 63 waiting sessions are blocked on stock_levels, and a restart would drop every in-flight transaction.

text.escalate_because: Rebuilding the index with CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY is a human decision
